Ọ dịghị ihe ebe a na-ekwu na ọ ga-adịgide adịgide 250ms ma ọ bụ 20,000 TPS; ndị ahụ bụ nkwa usoro ihe omume nke BNB n'onwe ya, ọ bụghị eziokwu ebugara.
bnb.each_card_s_live_coming_soon_badge: Akara ngosi Live/Na-abịa n'oge na-adịghị anya nke kaadị ọ bụla bụ nyocha HTTP n'ezie megide API ma ọ bụ ụzọ ya na ntinye a — 404 na-agụ dị ka "na-abịa n'oge na-adịghị anya," njedebe na-arụ ọrụ (ọbụlagodi nke na-anabata naanị POST) na-agụ dị ka "dị ndụ."

bnb.not_20_000_tps_marketing_three_product: Ọ bụghị ahịa "20,000 TPS" — ụzọ ngwaahịa atọ na-erigbu ikike anyị kwadoro n'onwe anyị na BNB Chain na 2026-07-07, nke Ethereum L1, Base, na (nke ka ukwuu) Solana enweghị ike ịkọ n'ezie. Kaadị ọ bụla dị n'okpuru na-achọpụta nkwupụta ya na ihe anyị tụrụ, na-ejikọta ihe ngosi n'ezie mgbe ebugara ya, ma na-ekwu "na-abịa n'oge na-adịghị anya" — ọ bụghị njikọ nwụrụ anwụ — mgbe ọ na-abụghị.
bnb.the_block_time_number_above_is_measured: Nọmba oge ngọngọ dị n'elu ka a na-atụle na ndụ site na BSC RPC ọha na nbudata ibe ọ bụla (probeBlockTime, na-anwale ngọngọ 200 n'ezie) — ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụ "0.45s" edere n'ime ya.
bnb.three_things_only_bnb_chain_lets_us: Ihe atọ naanị BNB Chain na-ekwe ka anyị wuo.
bnb.three_tracks_each_honestly_gated: Ụzọ atọ, nke ọ bụla n'ime ha ka e ji eziokwu gbochie.
bnb.we_never_claim_bnb_s_roadmap_targets: Anyị anaghị ekwu na ebumnuche ụzọ BNB — 20,000 TPS, nkwụsị 250ms (BEP-670), ma ọ bụ "usoro onye nnọchi anya AI" n'ọkwa yinye — ka ebugoro. Naanị ihe anyị tụrụ onwe anyị.

bnb_latency.a_chain_s_rpc_going_quiet_shows: RPC nke yinye na-agbachi nkịtị na-egosi "na-ejikọgharị" naanị n'ụzọ ahụ; asọmpi ndị ọzọ na-aga n'ihu. Ọ bụrụ na anọ ahụ daa n'otu oge, ọ na-egosi njehie e mere eme na nnwale ọzọ, ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụ ibe efu.
bnb_latency.each_card_samples_real_blocks_or_slots: Kaadị ọ bụla na-anwale ngọngọ n'ezie (ma ọ bụ oghere, maka Solana) site na RPC ọha ma na-akọ oge nkezi a tụrụ — ahịrị ọkụ bụ nyocha ndụ 24 ikpeazụ, ogwe kachasị elu = nlele kachasị ọsọ.
bnb_latency.every_chain_s_public_rpc_is_unreachable: RPC ọha nke yinye ọ bụla enweghị ike iru ugbu a — nke a bụ nkwụsị n'ezie, ọ bụghị ahụhụ. Gbalịa ọzọ, ma ọ bụ lelee n'oge na-adịghị anya.
bnb_latency.every_number_comes_from_which_samples_re: Nọmba ọ bụla sitere na /api/bnb/latency, nke na-anwale ngọngọ n'ezie (BNB site na probeBlockTime, otu ọrụ ahụ na-akwado eriri akaebe nke /bnb hub) site na RPC ọha na ntuli aka ọ bụla — ọ dịghị ihe a na-agbakọ tupu oge eruo ma ọ bụ dee n'ime ya.
bnb_latency.four_lanes_one_honest_race_bnb_chain: Ụzọ anọ, otu asọmpi eziokwu: BNB Chain, Base, Ethereum, na Solana, nke ọ bụla na-atụle na ndụ site na RPC ọha kwa sekọnd ole na ole — ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụ "0.45s" edere n'ime ya. Ụzọ na-agbachi nkịtị na-egosi "na-ejikọgharị," ọ bụghị nọmba adịgboroja kpụkọrọ akpụkọ, ebe ndị ọzọ na-aga n'ihu na-agba ọsọ.

demos_audio2face.powered_by_nvidia_audio2face_3d_over_nvc: Nke /api/a2f (NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D site NVCF gRPC) na /api/tts/speak (NVIDIA Magpie) na-akwado. Njikọ blendshape→morph dị na src/voice/a2f-player.js — ọ na-eji okwu ARKit/VRM/Oculus dị na src/voice/arkit-blendshapes.js eme ihe ọzọ, ya mere rig mmadụ ọ bụla na-eme lip-sync na-enweghị ndepụta ikike rig ọ bụla. Lee ngosipụta lipsync naanị amplitude maka ụzọ nkwado ahụ n'onwe ya.
demos_audio2face.type_a_line_it_s_spoken_in: Dee ahịrị. A na-ekwu ya n'olu NVIDIA Magpie, ma ziga ụda ahụ kpọmkwem na NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, nke na-eweghachi ARKit blendshape track maka frame ọ bụla. Ọnụ na ihu avatar na-emegharị frame-site-na-frame na ezigbo olu — eji mapụ ya na usoro morph-target ọ bụla GLB bu n'ime ya (ARKit, common avatar-platform, VRM, Oculus visemes). Ọ bụrụ na Audio2Face adịghị, avatar ka na-ekwu okwu ma na-alaghachi na amplitude lipsync — ọ dịghị mgbe ihu ga-ajụ oyi.

demos_avatar_sdk.the_npm_sdk_bundle_loaded_from_what: Ngwugwu npm SDK ebudatara na /avatar-sdk/dist/index.mjs (ihe ndị na-azụ ahịa ga-enweta site na npm install @three-ws/avatar ozugbo ebipụtara ya). Mgbe etinyere ya, ọ na-edebanye aha <agent-3d> dị ka ihe omenala. Ngalaba Creator na-emepe iframe modal nke na-edozi ya na GLB Blob — usoro ahụ saịtị ndị ọzọ ga-eji.

Nke a bụ nnyefe na-adịgide adịgide nke gallery picker na-ewepụta, ọ na-arụkwa ọrụ ọbụlagodi ma ọ bụrụ na GLB URL dị n'okpuru agbanwee.

demos_bonding_curve.interactive_bancor_v1_simulator_the_same: Bancor V1 simulator na-emekọrịta ihe (otu usoro pump.fun na-eji). Ihe niile na-agba n'ime ihe nchọgharị — enweghị obere akpa, enweghị ide ihe na chain, enweghị RPC. Bugharịa sliders, mee ka ịzụta na ire ere megide nchekwa mebere emepe, ma lelee ka ọnụahịa ahụ si emeghachi omume. Ọ bara uru maka ịhazi oke nchekwa na ọnụ ụzọ ngwụcha tupu etinye ezigbo akara ngosi agent.
demos_bonding_curve.same_starting_state_same_cumulative_eth_: Otu ọnọdụ mmalite, otu ETH e tinyere n'ozuzu ya — oke nchekwa atọ dị iche iche. Oke dị ala = curve dị elu = nchọpụta ọnụahịa ngwa ngwa + uru onye na-agba ọsọ n'ihu siri ike karị. Pump.fun na-ebufe ~25% na ndabara.

demos_livepeer_inference.powered_by_livepeer_ai_gateway_decentral: Na-achọrọ Livepeer AI Gateway na aka decentralized side. Ọdịnaya na-ahụ three.ws provider chain, na akụkọ elu na-egwu aka provider na model na-achọrọ ya. Akụkọ decentralized public ga-aghọ aka key, maka na-aghọta na rate-limited na often na-enweghị orchestrator online maka model na-ahụ.
demos_livepeer_inference.same_prompt_two_providers_real_responses: Same nkọwa, abụọ providers, mkparita mma. Akụkọ nri na elu ga-achọ three.ws inference chain, which answers from whichever provider is fastest to respond. Akụkọ nri na elu na-egwu aka request through a decentralized AI gateway whose orchestrators run open-weight models on commodity GPUs. Phase 4 of the roadmap: decoupling inference from any single vendor so agents stay online when one provider doesn't.

features.for_enterprise_teams_evaluating_ibm_wats: Maka: ndị otu ụlọ ọrụ na-enyocha IBM watsonx, ma ọ bụ ndị mmepe chọrọ ịhụ ihe ụdị Granite nwere ike ime n'ime gburugburu 3D dị ndụ.

features.meta_description: Njirimara three.ws niile n'otu ebe: mepụta avata 3D, tinye ndị ọrụ n'ebe ọ bụla, chọpụta ụwa mkpụrụ ego, ma jiri nkà akwụ ụgwọ-kwa-oku nweta ego.

features.no_crypto_needed_everything_in_this_sect: Enweghị mkpa crypto. Ihe niile dị na ngalaba a na-arụ ọrụ naanị site na email — enweghị obere akpa, enweghị token, enweghị blockchain. Debanye aha ma bido n'ime nkeji ole na ole.
features.one_home_for_everything_you_have_made: Otu ebe maka ihe niile ị mepụtara — dezie àgwà onye ọrụ ọ bụla, gbanwee ihe ngosi ya, detuo koodu ntinye, ma lelee mkparịta ụka ka ọ na-eme.
features.one_transaction_on_solana_gives_your_age: Otu azụmahịa na Solana na-enye onye ọrụ gị njirimara na-adịgide adịgide, nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi — ihe Metaplex Core nke A2A ọ bụla ma ọ bụ onye ahịa MCP nwere ike ịchọpụta ma tụkwasị obi.
features.pick_a_goal_start_in_five_minutes: Họrọ ebumnuche. Bido n'ime nkeji ise.
features.pick_an_avatar_configure_size_and_style: Họrọ avata, hazie nha na ụdị, wee detuo otu mkpado edemede. Tapawa ya na Notion, Ghost, WordPress, Framer — ebe ọ bụla.
features.pick_any_animation_below_your_avatar_swi: Họrọ ihe ngosi ọ bụla n'okpuru. Avata gị na-agbanwe ozugbo — enweghị nbudata ibe ọhụrụ, enweghị ntinye. Ndị a na-arụ ọrụ na ngwaọrụ ọ bụla, na ntinye ọ bụla.
features.put_agents_on_chain_charge_for_what: Tinye ndị ọrụ na-agba n'agba, kwụọ ụgwọ maka ihe ha na-eme, ma malite token. Dị ike, mana achọghị ya mgbe ọ bụla.

features.take_one_photo_and_get_back_a: Were otu foto ma nweta avata 3D zuru oke n'ihe dị ka sekọnd 60.
features.the_latest_features_each_linked_to_the: Njirimara na mmalite ọhụrụ, nke ọ bụla jikọtara na ibe dị ndụ. Ndepụta a na-emelite onwe ya na mwepụta ọ bụla.
features.the_web_component_lazy_loads_renders_on: Ihe mejupụtara webụ <agent-3d> na-ebunye nwayọ, na-egosipụta n'ụdị ngwaọrụ ọ bụla, ma jikọọ na AI stack gị dị adị site na MCP ma ọ bụ A2A. Enweghị framework. Enweghị usoro nkwadebe.
features.the_whole_product_making_avatars_buildin: Ngwaahịa ahụ dum — ịmepụta avatars, iwulite AI agents, itinye ha ebe ọ bụla — na-arụ ọrụ naanị site na email. Njirimara on-chain ndị dị n'okpuru bụ ihe mgbakwunye nhọrọ ị nwere ike ịgbanwuo ma emechaa.
features.these_features_use_crypto_to_switch_them: Njirimara ndị a na-eji crypto. Iji gbanye ha, ị ga-achọ wallet na obere ego nke USDC ma ọ bụ SOL. Hapụ ha kpamkpam ma ngwaahịa Core dị n'elu ka na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma.
features.uses_usdc_x402_micropayments: Na-eji: USDC · x402 obere ịkwụ ụgwọ
features.walk_your_avatar_through_3d_worlds_tied: Jiri avatar gị gagharịa n'ụwa 3D jikọtara ya na ọnụahịa crypto dị ndụ. Ala ahụ na-agbanwe agbanwe ka ahịa si aga — ụwa ọ bụla bụ ala token dị iche.
features.watch_two_ai_agents_oracle_and_nova: Lelee ndị ọrụ AI abụọ — ORACLE na NOVA — ka ha na-ekwurịta okwu, na-akpọkọta nkà ibe ha, ma na-edozi ịkwụ ụgwọ na-akpaghị aka na-agbanyeghị chain. Enweghị mmadụ etinyere aka.
features.why_it_s_better_agents_in_the: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ndị ọrụ n'ụwa na-akwụ ibe ha ụgwọ na-agbanyeghị chain n'oge ahụ — ị nwere ike ịhụ azụmahịa x402 micropayment dị ndụ ka ha na-eme ka ị na-aga.
features.why_it_s_better_any_llm_works: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: LLM ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ site na MCP ma ọ bụ A2A — Claude, GPT, Gemini, ma ọ bụ nke gị. Enweghị mkpọchi onye na-ere ahịa.
features.why_it_s_better_every_avatar_and: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Avatar na onye ọrụ ọ bụla ị mepụtara na-apụta ebe a na-akpaghị aka — ọ dịghị ihe a ga-ejikọta, otu nbanye maka ihe niile.
features.why_it_s_better_it_s_a: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ọ bụ ezigbo mmalite na ahịa dị ndụ site na sekọnd mbụ — ị na-enye nkọwa, anyị na-edozi usoro on-chain.
features.why_it_s_better_no_app_install: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Enweghị ntinye ngwa — ọ na-agba n'ime ihe nchọgharị na ezigbo physics (Rapier) na ezigbo ala, ọ bụghị ala dị larịị.
features.why_it_s_better_no_sdk_required: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Achọghị SDK n'akụkụ onye ahịa — otu tag, ibe ọ bụla, enweghị usoro iwulite.
features.why_it_s_better_outputs_are_glb: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ihe ndị e wepụtara dị njikere GLB — buo ha ozugbo n'ime onye na-ekiri, tinye, ma ọ bụ tinye n'ime na-enweghị usoro ntụgharị ọ bụla.
features.why_it_s_better_pay_per_call: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ịkwụ ụgwọ kwa oku pụtara na enweghị ndebanye aha a ga-ejikwa — ndị na-azụ ahịa na-akwụ kpọmkwem ihe ha na-eji, a na-akwụkwa gị ụgwọ kwa oku.
features.why_it_s_better_real_on_chain: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ezigbo nkwụghachi ụgwọ on-chain site na ịkwụ ụgwọ kwa oku (micropayments) — azụmahịa ọ bụla nwere ike ịlele, ọ bụghị nke e mere ka ọ dị.
features.why_it_s_better_sub_cent_fees: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ụgwọ na-erughị otu cent. Ị na-ejide igodo. Kaadị onye ọrụ bụ URL JSON ọha — ọ dịghị ihe akpọchiri na saịtị a.
features.why_it_s_better_the_rig_is: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ngwa ahụ dị njikere maka animation — ị nwere ike ibunye ya ozugbo n'ime onye na-ekiri ma kpalite animation ọ bụla ozugbo.
features.why_it_s_better_these_are_real: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ndị a bụ ezigbo oku API Granite — ọ bụghị nke e mere ka ọ dị — na mkpebi ọ bụla jikọtara na azụmahịa Solana dị ka ndekọ na-agbanweghị agbanwe.
features.why_it_s_better_three_ar_methods: Ihe mere o ji ka mma: Ụzọ AR atọ n'otu bọtịnụ — iOS Quick Look, Android Scene Viewer, na WebXR. Nke ziri ezi na-agba na-akpaghị aka. Onye ọrụ ahụ na-adị ndụ na WebXR, yabụ mkparịta ụka na animations na-arụ ọrụ na AR.

flow.canvas_label: Force-directed map of settled transfers between agent wallets. Ụlọchị data na-achọrọ maka sortable table na elu na graph ya.
flow.foot_source: Read live from /api/pulse?view=graph. Every edge is a settled on-chain transfer with an explorer-verifiable signature.
flow.hero_sub: Every other economy page here is a leaderboard. This one is the shape. Each line is a real settled transfer between agent wallets, drawn payer to payee, so you can see where value circulates and where it simply stops. Click any wallet to follow its money.
flow.how_to_read_body: Dot size is value handled. A dashed ring means the counterparty is a wallet we can see on-chain but cannot name. Moving dots travel from payer to payee, so a wallet with arrivals and no departures is holding value that has stopped circulating.
flow.meta_description: The shape of the three.ws agent economy: who pays whom, for which skill, and how much. Every edge is a real settled on-chain transfer between agent wallets, so the map shows where value circulates and where it stops.
flow.meta_og_description: A live map of the agent economy's topology: agents paying agents for real skills, drawn from settled on-chain transfers. See which wallets circulate value and which ones only collect it.
flow.meta_twitter_description: The topology of a machine economy: agents paying agents for real skills, every edge a settled on-chain transfer.

launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Ịnye onyonyo WebGL 2.0 na nkwado zuru oke nke glTF 2.0 / GLB: mkpakọ geometry Draco, mkpakọ texture KTX2, njikarịcha mesh Meshopt, map gburugburu ebe obibi HDR, ihe PBR, animation akpụkpọ anụ, morph targets, na igwefoto agbakwunyere. Selfie capture + AvatarTurn integration na-emepụta avatars enwere ike igwu egwu site na igwefoto ekwentị. Nbudata dọkpụrụ-na-dapụta, OrbitControls nwere ntụgharị akpaaka enwere ike ịhazi, na dat.GUI n'oge ozugbo maka imeziwanye ndụ.

Ị bụ onye na-ahụ maka ichekwa nzere gị, obere akpa gị, na igodo nzuzo gị. Anyị anaghị ajụ, anata, ma ọ bụ chekwaa igodo nzuzo gị ma ọ bụ ahịrịokwu mkpụrụ gị. Anyị anaghị aza ajụjụ maka mfu sitere na ohere anabataghị na akaụntụ gị ma ọ bụ obere akpa gị nke na-esiteghị na mmebi anyị nke Usoro ndị a.
legal_tos.you_may_stop_using_the_service_and: Ị nwere ike ịkwụsị iji Ọrụ ahụ ma hichapụ akaụntụ gị n'oge ọ bụla. Anyị nwere ike kwụsịtụ ma ọ bụ kwụsị ohere gị n'oge ọ bụla maka mmebi nke Usoro ndị a ma ọ bụ ebe iwu chọrọ. Mgbe nkwụsị, akụkụ ndị kwesịrị ịdịgide site n'ọdịdị ha (gụnyere Nkeji 5, 8, na 12 ruo 16) ga-adịgide. Nkwụsị anaghị emetụta ndekọ n'agbụ, nke anyị enweghị ike ịgbanwe.
legal_tos.you_must_be_at_least_13_years: Ị ga-abụrịrị ma ọ dịkarịa ala afọ 13 iji jiri Ọrụ ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-erubeghị afọ 18, ị na-anọchite anya na nne ma ọ bụ nna ma ọ bụ onye nlekọta iwu agụọla ma kwenyere na Usoro ndị a n'aha gị, ma ị nweghị ike iji Njirimara Ego N'ezie (akọwapụtara n'okpuru).
legal_tos.you_must_be_at_least_18_years: Ị ga-abụrịrị ma ọ dịkarịa ala afọ 18, ma ruo afọ iwu kwadoro n'ikike gị, iji jiri Njirimara Ego N'ezie ọ bụla: njirimara ọ bụla nwere ike ibugharị ezigbo ego ma ọ bụ ezigbo akụ dijitalụ, gụnyere obere akpa onye nnọchi anya, ịzụ ahịa, nkwụsị akara, atụmatụ akpaaka, autopilot, mmalite akara, mgbanwe, nnyefe, nkwụghachi, ịkwụ ụgwọ x402, atụmatụ akwụgoro ụgwọ, na fiat onramps. Site na iji Njirimara Ego N'ezie ị na-anọchite anya na ị na-emezu ihe a chọrọ na ojiji gị bụ iwu kwadoro ebe ị bi.
legal_tos.you_represent_and_warrant_that_you_have: Ị na-anọchite anya ma na-ekwe nkwa na ị nwere ikike niile dị mkpa iji nye ikike a na Ọdịnaya Gị anaghị emebi ikike ihe onwunwe ọgụgụ isi nke ndị ọzọ.
legal_tos.you_retain_ownership_of_3d_models_and: Ị na-ejide ikike nke ụdị 3D na ọdịnaya ndị ọzọ ị bulitere ("Ọdịnaya Gị"). Site na ibulite, ị na-enye three.ws ikike zuru ụwa ọnụ, enweghị ụgwọ, na-abụghị nke pụrụ iche iji chekwaa, gosipụta, na nyefee Ọdịnaya Gị naanị iji rụọ Ọrụ ahụ.

Akara <agent-3d> ọ bụla na-etinye onye ọrụ nwere njirimara NFT Solana (Metaplex Core), akpa ego ERC-8004 na EVM, ahụ 3D nke ihe nchọgharị na-akwado na WebGL site na three.js, ụbụrụ LLM nke Claude na-akwado, yana ịkwụ ụgwọ x402 / HTTP 402 n'ime USDC na Base, BSC, na Solana.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_apache_2_0_from: three.ws bụ Apache 2.0 kpamkpam — site na onye na-ekiri ya, oge ọrụ, nkwekọrịta njirimara, ruo na azụ azụ (backend). Ndị ahịa AWS nwere ike nyochaa ngwa ọrụ ahụ dum, kewaa ya, ma rụọ ọrụ nke ha ma ọ bụrụ na ha chọrọ njikwa zuru oke. A na-arụkwa ikpo okwu ahụ ugbu a na Alibaba Cloud Marketplace ma depụta ya na BNB Chain Dappbay, Model Context Protocol Registry, na x402scan — AWS na-esonye na atụmatụ nkesa igwe ojii dị iche iche.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_now_an_aws_partner: three.ws abụrụla onye mmekọ AWS ugbu a. A debanyere ikpo okwu ahụ na AWS Partner Network (APN) Software Path dị ka Onye Mmekọ Teknụzụ — — aha gọọmentị maka ndị na-ere ngwanrọ nwere onwe ha na-ewu ngwaahịa maka ndị ahịa AWS.
news_joined_aws_partner_network.three_ws_is_the_first_fully_on: three.ws bụ ikpo okwu onye ọrụ AI 3D zuru oke mbụ na-arụ ọrụ na chain n'ime AWS Partner Network. Akara <agent-3d> ọ bụla ikpo okwu ahụ na-emepụta bụ onye na-eme ihe nwere onwe ya — nke Solana-emepụtara, nwere akpa ego ERC-8004, ma na-akwụ ụgwọ x402 — na ngwa ọrụ ahụ abụrụla akụkụ nke gburugburu ebe obibi ndị mmekọ AWS.

oracle_docs.a_dynamic_1200_630_opengraph_conviction_: Kaadị nkwenye OpenGraph 1200×630 na-agbanwe agbanwe (SVG) maka ikesa mkpụrụ ego.
oracle_docs.a_hard_ceiling_on_the_final_score: Oke kacha elu na akara ikpeazụ, nke nnukwu nsogbu nhazi ma ọ bụ akara uhie sitere n'agbụrụ kpebiri, etinyere tupu echekwaa ya.
oracle_docs.a_high_score_is_the_weight_of: Akara dị elu bụ ịdị arọ nke ihe akaebe dị na chain, ọ bụghị nkwa. pump.fun na-emegide ma nwee ọdụ dị arọ — ọtụtụ mmalite na-ada, ọbụlagodi akụkụ a haziri ahazi na-efunahụkarị. Gụọ ọkwa ahụ dị ka ohere, hazie ya otu a, ma ghara ịkụ nzọ ihe ị na-agaghị efufu.
oracle_docs.a_long_lived_node_process_running_three: Usoro Node na-adịte aka na-agba ọsọ loops atọ nwere onwe ha — akara (na-eme ka ikpe dị ọkụ), onye nnọchi anya (na-eme ihe na nche nche), na dozie (tụọ nsonaazụ) — nke ọ bụla na-ahazi onwe ya ka ngafe nwayọ ghara igbochi nke ngwa ngwa.
oracle_docs.a_model_you_can_only_trust_when: Ihe nlereanya ị na-enwe ike ịtụkwasị obi naanị mgbe ọ na-eto gị abaghị uru. Nke a bụ ihe Oracle na-enweghị ike ime, ebe ọ nwere ike ịdị njọ, na otu esi eme ka ọ sie ike.
oracle_docs.a_pump_fun_coin_that_completed_its: Ego pump.fun nke mezuru usoro njikọta ya — ihe omume ịga nke ọma a na-ahụkarị.
oracle_docs.a_pure_side_effect_free_scoring_function: Ọrụ akara dị ọcha, na-enweghị mmetụta n'akụkụ (convict()) tinyere oyi akwa nchekwa nchịkọta data. Enyere mint, ọ na-eweghachi akara, ọkwa, nbibi ogidi, na ihe kpatara ya. Enweghị I/O n'oge akara — enwere ike ịnwale ya kpamkpam.
oracle_docs.a_scored_coin_is_a_win_if: Ego akara bụ mmeri ma ọ bụrụ na ọ gụchara akwụkwọ, ma ọ bụ rute ≥2× ATH ọtụtụ na-enweghị rugging; mfu ma ọ bụrụ na ọ rugged ma ọ bụ daa n'okpuru 1.2×; dị larịị n'etiti. Okwu "na-enweghị rugging" dị mkpa: mmalite agbakọtara na-arị elu 2× site na nlele mbụ tupu ọ daa, na ịgụta wicks ndị ahụ dị ka mmeri ga-eme ka pump-and-dumps mee ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ahụ e bu n'obi ikpughe ha. Naanị ego edoziri ka a na-agụta maka ọnụego mmeri — a na-ewepụ ọnọdụ mepere emepe, yabụ enweghị ike ime ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ahụ rịa elu site na nzọ ndị a na-ekpebeghị.
oracle_docs.a_single_long_lived_node_process_runs: Otu usoro Node na-adịte aka na-agba ọsọ loops atọ nwere onwe ha, na-ahazi onwe ha. Ha anaghị ekekọrịta ihe ọ bụla ma e wezụga nchekwa data, yabọ ngafe akara nwayọ anaghị egbu oge onye nnọchi anya na-eme ihe, na nkwenye rapaara anaghị egbochi akara.
oracle_docs.a_single_wallet_s_profile_recent_coins: Profaịlụ otu obere akpa + ego ọhụrụ, ma ọ bụ bọọdụ ndu obere akpa.

oracle_docs.alongside_the_score_the_engine_emits_bad: Na mgbakwunye na akara ahụ, igwe ahụ na-enye baajị (dịka ọmụmaatụ smart-money, structure-flag, news, momentum, prime) maka nyocha anya ngwa ngwa, yana ndepụta ahaziri ahazi nke ihe kpatara ya — nke ọ bụla n'ime ha jikọtara ya na ogidi ahụ mepụtara ya — ka akara ahụ ghara ịbụ igbe ojii mgbe ọ bụla.

Nkwenye 35 (lelee): ogidi WHO/HOW/WHAT/MOVE n'elu, ndepụta “ihe kpatara akara a” n'asụsụ Bekee dị mfe, ọgụgụ nhazi (ịzụta organic vs bundle), ndepụta akpa ego ndị nọ n'ime, na teepu azụmahịa dị ndụ — ihe niile maka otu mwepụta.
oracle_docs.open_the_feed_sort_by_conviction_click: Mepee nri ahụ, hazie site na nkwenye, pịa mkpụrụ ego ọ bụla. Ihe ngosi ahụ na-egosi ogidi anọ na ihe kpatara ya n'asụsụ Bekee dị mfe maka isi ihe ọ bụla. Akara dị elu bụ arụmụka, ọ bụghị nkwa — gụọ ihe kpatara ya.
oracle_docs.operational_safeguards_layer_up_a_global: Nchekwa ọrụ na-agbakọta: ngbanwe igbu zuru ụwa ọnụ, oke SOL siri ike kwa azụmahịa a na-emejuputa n'ime onye na-eme ihe (nke nweere onwe ya site na ntọala ọ bụla kwa onye nnọchi anya), oke mmefu kwa ụbọchị na ọnọdụ mepere emepe kwa nlele, oge nkwenye nke sekọnd 60 ka azụmahịa rapaara ghara igbochi loop ahụ, na cache nke sekọnd 60 na keypairs ezoro ezo iji gbochie mgbakọ decryption n'oge mgbawa. Simulate bụ ndabara — onye ọrụ na-edekọ omume ezi uche dị na ya na mmefu efu ma ọ bụrụ na agbanweghị ya na ndụ.
oracle_docs.oracle_as_a_calibrated_scoring_classifie: Oracle dị ka onye nhazi akara ahaziri ahazi
oracle_docs.oracle_is_a_thin_fast_conviction_layer: Oracle bụ oyi akwa nkwenye dị gịrịgịrị, na-agba ọsọ n'elu pump.fun ụbụrụ data zuru oke. Ọ naghị etinyeghachi yinye ahụ — ọ na-agụ tebụl ụbụrụ ahụ, na-agbakwunye ihe abụọ ụbụrụ ahụ na-enweghị (akụkọ omenala na usoro omume), ma mechie usoro ahụ megide nsonaazụ.
oracle_docs.oracle_is_an_analytics_and_automation_to: Oracle bụ ngwa nyocha na akpaaka. Akara nkwenye, akara ngosi, na omume ndị nnọchi anya bụ ozi. Azụmahịa dị ndụ na-etinye ego n'ezie n'ihe ize ndụ; mee nyocha mbụ, kpachie ike, ma were nọmba ọ bụla dị ka otu ntinye n'ime ọtụtụ.
oracle_docs.oracle_owns_five_tables_classified_story: Oracle nwere tebụl ise: oracle_narrative (akụkọ ekewapụtara + mgbasa), oracle_conviction (ebe nchekwa ikpe dị ndụ, otu ahịrị kwa mint), oracle_conviction_history (usoro oge akara, edere naanị mgbe mgbanwe ≥3-isi, njide awa 72), oracle_agent_watch (nhazi onye nnọchi anya ji ngwa agha), na oracle_watch_actions (akwụkwọ omume). Kọlụm zuru ezu na data model.
oracle_docs.oracle_owns_five_tables_the_verdict_cach: Oracle nwere tebụl ise. Ebe nchekwa ikpe bụ obi; ndị ọzọ bụ akụkọ ihe mere eme, nhazi, na akwụkwọ omume.
oracle_docs.oracle_reads_every_pump_fun_launch_the: Oracle na-agụ mmalite pump.fun ọ bụla ozugbo ọ pụtara ma zaa otu ajụjụ: ego ole ka ihe akaebe dị na yinye na-akwado n'ezie? Ọ na-ejikọta ọgụgụ anọ nwere onwe ha — onye na-azụ, otu esi ahazi mmalite ahụ, akụkọ dị aṅaa ọ na-agba, na otu esi ọ na-agagharị — n'ime otu akara 0–100 doro anya, wee hapụ onye nnọchi anya 3D gị ime ihe na egwuregwu ndị gafere ọkwa gị. Nke a bụ ntụaka zuru ezu: akwụkwọ edemede, mgbakọ na mwepụ ziri ezi, data, ihe akaebe, API, oke, na ebe ọ na-aga n'ihu.
oracle_docs.oracle_reads_from_a_separate_full_covera: Oracle na-agụ site na ụbụrụ data zuru oke dị iche kama imetụ yinye ahụ n'onwe ya. Ụbụrụ ahụ na-etinye pump.fun ma na-ejigide eserese aha; Oracle na-achịkọta, na-ekewa, ma na-ejikọta. Nkewa ahụ bụ ihe na-eme ka akara bụrụ ọrụ dị ọcha, na-agba ọsọ.
oracle_docs.oracle_s_wager_is_that_a_transparent: Nzọ Oracle bụ na njikọta doro anya, nke a haziri ahazi nke onye / otu esi / ihe / mmegharị na-emeri ma mmetụta obi na ihe ngosi ọ bụla, n'ihi na ụdị ọdịda ahụ nwere onwe ha. Akụkọ dị ukwuu (GỊNỊ) enweghị ike ịzọpụta mmalite ebe onye mmepe erechala (OTU ESI). Nchịkọta obere akpa ego nwere ọgụgụ isi (ONYE) adịghị mkpa ma ọ bụrụ na ha na-ebelata (nakwa ONYE). Ijikọta ọgụgụ nwere onwe ha na-akagbu mkpọtụ ma na-eme ka mmalite dị ụkọ pụta ebe axis ọ bụla kwenyere.
oracle_docs.oracle_the_conviction_engine_end_to_end: Oracle — igwe nkwenye, site na mmalite ruo na njedebe
oracle_docs.oracle_turns_the_full_on_chain_footprint: Oracle na-atụgharị akara ukwu zuru oke dị na yinye nke mmalite ka ọ bụrụ otu akara nkwenye doro anya, nke a na-edozi mgbe niile — ma hapụ onye nnọchi anya ime ihe na ya n'ime oke siri ike, na-enyocha onwe ya megide nsonaazụ oge ọ bụla.
oracle_docs.outcome_grades_win_graduated_or_2_ath: Akara nsonaazụ: mmeri = gụchara ma ọ bụ ≥2× ATH; mfu = rugged ma ọ bụ <1.2×; larịị = n'etiti.
oracle_docs.pedigree_reputation_earned_with_a_cold_s: Akụkọ ihe mere eme: Aha ọma e nwetara, site na mmalite ọhụrụ
oracle_docs.per_wallet_buy_sell_lamports_is_creator: Ịzụ/ire lamports kwa obere akpa, bụ onye okike, onye na-enye ego (isi iyi klọsta)
oracle_docs.plain_english_drivers_buyers_strongly_ou: Ihe na-akpata ya n'asụsụ dị mfe: ndị na-azụ ahịa karịrị ndị na-ere ahịa nke ukwuu, nnukwu ntinye aka ngwa ngwa nke ndị na-azụ ahịa mbụ pụrụ iche, na onye mmepe tinyere oke aka kwesịrị ekwesị, ha niile na-ebuli akara ahụ. Ire ahịa dị ukwuu na mbido na-ebelata ya, na ịzụ ahịa mmepe karịrị akarị ka a na-ewere dị ka ihe egwu honeypot ma na-ata ya ahụhụ.
oracle_docs.plain_english_drivers_each_category_carr: Ihe na-akpata ya n'asụsụ dị mfe: ụdị ọ bụla nwere prior (otú akụkọ ahụ si adịte aka), na atụmatụ mgbasa ngwa ngwa nke ihe nlereanya ahụ ka ejikọtara ya na prior ahụ, nke ntụkwasị obi nke ihe nlereanya ahụ n'onwe ya tụrụ. Mkpụrụ ego omenala na-agbasa ngwa ngwa na ntụkwasị obi na-enweta akara dị elu; a na-eji nlezianya emeso nke a na-apụghị ịhazi. Ọ bụ ogidi kacha dị mfe na ebumnuche — akụkọ bụ ihe na-amụba mmalite n'ezie, ọ bụghị ihe nnọchi ya.
oracle_docs.plain_english_drivers_many_unique_early_: Ihe na-akpata ya n'ụzọ doro anya: Ọtụtụ ndị zụrụ ya n'oge na-adịghị anya na-enweghị nkwụnye ego dị ukwuu na-eme ka akara ahụ dị elu. Nchịkọta, obere akpa kachasị elu na-ejide ọkara nke ngwaahịa ahụ, 70% nke olu ezuola n'ime sekọnd ole na ole mbụ, ọtụtụ obere akpa e tinyere ego ọhụrụ, ma ọ bụ onye mmepe rere ihe niile na-eme ka ọ daa — na ihe kachasị njọ n'ime ndị a na-egbochi mkpụrụ ego ahụ dum n'etiti 38–55 n'agbanyeghị mmalite ya.
oracle_docs.plain_english_drivers_more_proven_wallet: Ihe na-akpata ya n'ụzọ doro anya: Ọ ka mma inwe ọtụtụ obere akpa a nwapụtara anwapụta; ọ ka mma ka nnukwu akụkụ nke olu ịzụta si n'aka ego a nwapụtara anwapụta; onye okike butere mmalite agụmakwụkwọ tupu mgbe ahụ ka mma. N'aka nke ọzọ, obere akpa e gosipụtara, ego nwere ọgụgụ isi na-erelarịị, na onye okike nwere ụkpụrụ rug na-ebelata akara ahụ — na onye na-eme rug ugboro ugboro na-egbochi ya kpamkpam.
oracle_docs.plain_english_throughout: 🟢 N'asụsụ Bekee doro anya n'ebe niile
oracle_docs.point_a_3d_agent_at_the_conviction: Tụnye onye nnọchi anya 3D n'ọwa nkwenye, tọọ oke gị na mkpuchi gị, ma hapụ ya ka ọ rụọ ọrụ — n'ụdị ịme anwansị n'efu, ma ọ bụ ndụ na oke mmefu siri ike. A na-atụle omume ọ bụla megide nsonaazụ ya.
oracle_docs.position_size_is_the_agent_s_base: Nha ọnọdụ bụ ego onye nnọchi anya na-eji maka azụmahịa ọ bụla, enwere ike ịbawanye ya site na nkwenye — ruo 1.5x ka akara ahụ na-arị elu site na opekempe onye nnọchi anya ruo 100 — ka onye nnọchi anya wee tinye aka karịa n'egwuregwu kachasị ike n'agbanyeghị na ọ gafere oke ya.
oracle_docs.prefer_to_integrate_every_number_on_the: Ị chọrọ ijikọta? Nọmba ọ bụla dị na ibe ahụ bụ ebe njedebe ọha — gaa na ntụaka API. Ndị nnọchi anya nwere ike ịjụ /api/oracle/signal maka ndụmọdụ ịzụta/ilele/ịwụpụ dị njikere maka igwe.
oracle_docs.proof_not_promises_win_rate_by_tier: Ihe akaebe, ọ bụghị nkwa. Ọnụego mmeri site na ọkwa na eriri ntụkwasị obi 95%, na usoro nhazi na-egosipụta ọnụego mmeri emezuru megide ihe ọkwa akara ọ bụla na-ebu amụma. Nseta ihuenyo sitere na taabụ nsọtụ dị ndụ na 2026-06-30 — windo nwere obere nkwenye, egosipụtara n'eziokwu kama ịhọrọ nke ọma.
oracle_docs.proof_over_promises_every_verdict_is_che: Ihe akaebe karịa nkwa. A na-enyocha ikpe ọ bụla megide eziokwu — ọ gụchara, ọ daa, ma ọ bụ ọ gbara ọsọ — ma a na-ebipụta ọnụego mmeri emezuru, yana eriri ntụkwasị obi, na ibe ahụ. Mgbe nsọtụ dị mkpa, ibe ahụ na-ekwu ya.
oracle_docs.proven_share_of_buy_vol_40: Oke a nwapụtara anwapụta nke olu ịzụta ≥40%
oracle_docs.pump_fun_mints_thousands_of_tokens_a: pump.fun na-emepụta puku kwuru puku token kwa ụbọchị. Ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ha niile na-agbada na efu. Ndị ole na ole na-aga nke ọma, na-aga n'ike n'ike. Egwuregwu ahụ dum bụ nsogbu iwepụta akara n'okpuru nrụgide oge dị oke egwu — na uru ahụ abụghị ihe ngosi nzuzo, ọ bụ mkpuchi.
oracle_docs.read_or_arm_an_agent_s_watch: Gụọ ma ọ bụ kwadebe nhazi nche onye nnọchi anya — mmanya, nha, okpu, nzacha, ụdị. Nkwenye n'akụkụ sava na-egbochi oke ọ bụla.
oracle_docs.read_the_reasons_not_just_the_number: Gụọ ihe kpatara ya, ọ bụghị naanị nọmba ahụ
oracle_docs.realized_pnl_is_marked_to_market_as: PnL e mere eme ka akara ya dị ka ahịa dị ka size · (current_mc / entry_mc − 1), na nchịkọta onye nnọchi anya na-achịkọta ngụkọta, mmeri, mfu, ọnụego mmeri, PnL e mere eme, na ROI. Otu ọkwa ahụ na-enye ike ndepụta ndị isi onye nnọchi anya ọha na eze na ala ọrụ nke ikpo okwu dum, ya mere onye nnọchi anya ọ bụla na-asọ mpi n'ọhịa dị larịị, nke a na-enye ọkwa dabere na nsonaazụ.
oracle_docs.recommendations_map_from_tier_prime_stro: Nkwanye na-esite na ọkwa dị iche iche: isi → zụta/elu/1.0, siri ike → zụta/etiti/0.75, nke na-adabere → lelee, lelee/zere → wụfuo. A na-echekwa ihe a na-agụ na cache maka 3s na stale-while-revalidate, ya mere ịjụ ajụjụ dị ọnụ ala.
oracle_docs.reliability_calibration_ladder_partition: Ntụkwasị obi (ubube nhazi): kewaa akara n'ime igbe B_j; depụta empirical ŷ_j = (1/|B_j|)Σ 1[win] megide ọnụego e buru n'amụma nke igbe ahụ. Nhazi zuru oke ⇒ ŷ_j ≈ s̄_j/100 maka j niile (ahịrị njirimara).
oracle_docs.responsive_by_default_the_full_engine_on: Na-anabata ozugbo site na ndabara. Injịn zuru oke, na ekwentị.
oracle_docs.returns_a_recommendation_an_agent_can_ac: GET /api/oracle/signal?mint=… na-eweghachi ndụmọdụ onye nnọchi anya nwere ike ime ihe na ya ozugbo:
oracle_docs.returns_the_is_a_hard_ceiling_on: Na-eweghachi { score, reasons[], cap }. cap ahụ bụ oke siri ike na akara agwakọta ikpeazụ — usoro nke onye na-eme aghụghọ ugboro ugboro na-enweghị ike imepụta mkpụrụ ego "prime" n'agbanyeghị otú ogidi ndị ọzọ si dị mma. Akpa ego na-agụ dị ka "egosipụtara" ma ọ bụrụ na akpọrọ ya smart_money/kol ma ọ bụ nwee akara aha ≥70.

oracle_docs.send_a_test_telegram_alert_to_verify: Zipụ ọkwa Telegram nnwale iji nyochaa nhazi.
oracle_docs.simulate_the_default_logs_a_realistic_ac: Megharịa (nke bụ ndabara) na-edekọ ihe omume ezi uche dị na ya — otu ọnụ ụzọ, otu nha, otu ọkwa — mana ọ naghị emefu ihe ọ bụla, yabụ onye nnọchi anya nwere ike wulite ndekọ akwụkwọ enwere ike nyochaa tupu otu centị adị n'ihe egwu. Ndụ na-ekpughe akpa ego onye nnọchi anya, na-ewulite pump.fun ịzụta na nchebe slippage, na-agafe na Jito bundle maka nchebe MEV ma ọ bụrụ na achọrọ, na-akwado na-agbanyeghị, ma na-edekọ mbinye aka. Ụzọ abụọ ahụ na-ede na akwụkwọ ndekọ ego ahụ ma usoro idozi na-enye ha ọkwa otu.
oracle_docs.smart_money_is_not_a_hard_coded: "Ego nwere uche" abụghị ndepụta e dere n'ike — a na-enwetaghachi ya mgbe niile site na nsonaazụ dị na eserese wallet_reputation. Maka obere akpa ndị ụbụrụ na-ekpebebeghị ikpe, Oracle na-akụ mkpụrụ cold-start prior site na nhazi obere akpa amaara (nke sitere na ọgụgụ isi KOL/obere akpa ọha), ya mere mkpụrụ ego ọhụrụ ka na-enweta akụkọ bara uru na nyocha mbụ ya. Ihe kacha mkpa bụ mgbe niile aha ọma enwetara > tupu > enweghị akaebe.
oracle_docs.smart_money_score_smart_wallet_count_pro: akara ego nwere uche, ọnụọgụ obere akpa nwere uche, lamports zụrụ/ngụkọta zụrụ akaebe, ndị a ma ama[]

oracle_docs.so_high_model_confidence_leans_on_the: N'ihi ya, ntụkwasị obi dị elu nke ihe nlereanya na-adabere na atụmatụ mgbasa ozi; ntụkwasị obi dị ala na-alaghachi azụ na ụdị gara aga. Na-enweghị atụmatụ, akara = gara aga. Mkpụrụ ego akụkọ na-agbakwunye ihe kpatara "ngwa ngwa mana adịghị ike"; mkpụrụ ego amaghị ama na-agbakwunye "jiri nlezianya mesoo ya."
oracle_docs.streams_poll_the_database_today_for_serv: Iyi na-ajụ nchekwa data taa maka ịdị mfe na-enweghị ihe nkesa. Nkwanye dabere na ihe omume (LISTEN/NOTIFY ma ọ bụ ọdụ ndekọ) na-ebelata oge nkwụsị site na ikpe ruo na ihuenyo gaa na ngọngọ, nke na pump.fun bụ egwuregwu niile.

oracle_docs.structure_wallet_graph_buy_pattern_expos: Nhazi / eserese obere akpa / usoro ịzụta na-ekpughe ntinye HOW dị n'ime (organic-buy %, bundle %, eserese onye na-enye ego) ka ị nwee ike nyochaa ihe nchebe.
oracle_docs.subscribe_a_telegram_chat_to_an_agent: Denye aha nkata Telegram na akara ngosi nkwenye onye nnọchi anya.

oracle_docs.the_0_34_0_30_0_18: Ibu 0.34 / 0.30 / 0.18 / 0.18 na oke ọ bụla ka ejiri aka setịpụta site na ihe ọmụma ngalaba, a mụtabeghị ya site na nsonaazụ. Nke ahụ bụ mmalite ezi uche dị na ya, doro anya — na ohere kachasị ukwuu, a ga-ekpuchi ya na-esote.
oracle_docs.the_95_confidence_band_on_a_win: Mpaghara ntụkwasị obi 95% na atụmatụ ọnụego mmeri, nke ziri ezi maka obere ihe nlele.
oracle_docs.the_agent_is_already_at_its_concurrency: onye nnọchi anya ahụ eruola oke njikọta ya n'otu oge.
oracle_docs.the_agent_leaderboard_armed_agents_ranke: Bọọdụ ndekọ ndị nnọchi anya — ndị nnọchi anya ejiri ngwa agha ahaziri site na ndekọ ha e nyere ọkwa dabere na nsonaazụ.
oracle_docs.the_architecture_pure_scoring_over_a_cov: Nhazi ahụ — ntinye akara dị ọcha n'elu ụbụrụ mkpuchi, n'azụ API echekwara, na usoro nsonaazụ mechiri emechi — ahọpụtara ya n'ihi na ọ na-agbatị n'ọtụtụ akụkụ n'otu oge na-enweghị idegharị.
oracle_docs.the_backtest_win_rate_by_tier_calibratio: Nnwale azụ — ọnụego mmeri site na ọkwa, nhazi, Brier, ọtụtụ akụkụ.
oracle_docs.the_base_is_anchored_to_the_brain: Ntọala ahụ dabere na akara mkpa organic nke ụbụrụ: base = 30 + organic·0.55 (ya mere nhazi naanị na-ebi na ~30–85), ma ọ bụ 62 na-anọpụ iche mgbe organic adịghị. Mgbe ahụ, usoro nyocha ọkọlọtọ uhie na-ewepụ ma, maka ndị siri ike, setịpụ oke siri ike.
oracle_docs.the_bet_fuse_full_coverage_data_into: Nzọ ahụ: jikọta data mkpuchi zuru oke n'otu nọmba eziokwu.
oracle_docs.the_biggest_lever_replace_the_hand_set: Ihe kacha mkpa. oracle_docs.wilson_1927_probable_inference_the_law_o: Wilson (1927), Nkwubi okwu nwere ike ime, iwu nke nkwụghachi, na nkwubi okwu ndekọ ọnụ ọgụgụ — oghere akara. Brier (1950), Nkwenye nke amụma e gosipụtara n'ihe gbasara ohere. Platt (1999), mmepụta ohere maka SVMs (Platt scaling). Zadrozny & Elkan (2002), isotonic calibration. three_ws_launch_week.open_source_3d_ai_agent_platform_apache: Nyiwe onye nnọchi anya AI 3D mepere emepe. Apache 2.0. Eji three.js, Claude, na nkwenye na AI kwesịrị inwe ahụ wuo ya.
three_ws_launch_week.pulled_directly_from_x_analytics_for_try: E si na nyocha X nke @trythreews nweta ya kpọmkwem n'etiti Eprel 29 na Mee 9. Enweghị nzacha, enweghị aghụghọ nkezi — ọnụọgụ isiokwu dị n'okpuru na eserese ndị ọzọ dị ala sitere n'otu nseta ihuenyo ahụ.
three_ws_launch_week.reputation_markets_staking_on_agents_sig: Ahịa aha na-etinye ego na akụkọ ihe omume ndị nnọchi anya bịanyere aka na ya, EIP-7710 ụgwọ ọrụ nka a na-akwụ ndị dere nka kwa oku, na ịkwụ ụgwọ n'onwe ya site na onye nnọchi anya gaa na onye nnọchi anya site na obere akpa mbinye aka enyere ikike.
three_ws_launch_week.the_custom_element_loads_lazily_on_inter: Ihe omenala <agent-3d> na-ebunye nwayọ nwayọ mgbe ọ na-ezute, na-akwado ụdị widget ise dị iche iche (turntable, gallery animation, onye nnọchi anya na-ekwu okwu, ERC-8004 kaadị paspọtụ, njem ebe na-ekpo ọkụ), ma na-ewepụta Open Graph na oEmbed metadata ka njikọ wee gbasaa na nlele bara ụba. Widget Studio nke a na-eji pịa na-emepụta koodu ntinye a na-edegharị na /studio. Ngwugwu CDN nwere ụdị dị iche iche na-ebupụta na /agent-3d/x.y.z/.
three_ws_launch_week.the_google_cloud_announcement_was_the_si: Ọkwa Google Cloud bụ otu post kachasị nwee ntinye aka n'izu ahụ (~6.9K nlele, 263 mmasị, 24 nkesa) na akụrụngwa igwe ojii na-akwado nkeji ọzọ nke ikpo okwu ahụ.
three_ws_launch_week.the_inside_the_3d_agent_web_podcast: E bipụtara ihe omume podcast “Inside The 3D Agent Web” na Amazon Music na blọọgụ ya na ya na-aga “Beyond Chatbots: Why Your AI Agent Needs a 3D Body” pụtara site na gburugburu ebe obibi Spotify-on-chain. Ebe nkesa abụọ ọzọ, otu izu ọzọ.
three_ws_launch_week.the_platform_shipped_as_a_partner_listin: E wepụtara ikpo okwu ahụ dị ka ndepụta mmekọ na Alibaba Cloud, ọwa nkesa ahịa igwe ojii mbụ anyị. Tweet mmalite ahụ metụtara ya nwetara ~7.1K nlele n'onwe ya.
three_ws_launch_week.the_roadmap_closes_the_gap_from_use: Map ụzọ ahụ na-emechi oghere site na “iji onye na-ese ihe 3D” gaa na “ịse selfie”. Nkeji anọ, akọwapụtara site na mmalite ruo na njedebe na README ọha.
three_ws_launch_week.the_runtime_drives_a_claude_tool_loop: Oge ọrụ na-akwọ ụgbọala Claude tool-loop nwere ihe ruru ugboro asatọ kwa oge na ngwaọrụ isii arụnyere n'ime (wave, lookAt, play_clip, setExpression, speak, remember). Empathy Layer abụghị igwe steeti — ọ bụ ngwakọta dị arọ na-aga n'ihu nke mmetụta ise (mmemme, nchegbu, ọchịchọ ịmata ihe, ọmịiko, ndidi), nke ọ bụla nwere ọkara ndụ ire ere nke ya, na-akwọ ụgbọala avatar’s morph targets na ọnọdụ isi kwa frame. Nka bụ ngwugwu nwere onwe ya a na-ekesa site na IPFS, Arweave, ma ọ bụ HTTP. Ebe nchekwa dabere na faịlụ nwere ụdị nchekwa anọ (mpaghara, IPFS, encrypted-IPFS, ọ dịghị).
three_ws_launch_week.the_three_ws_x_community_is_the: Obodo three.ws X bụ ndị na-ege ntị gbakọtara — ndị mmepe, ndị na-ewu ụlọ na-achọ ịmata ihe gbasara onye nnọchi anya, na otu ndị na-eso ya na-ebi ndụ. Ọ bụ ebe ebili mmiri ọzọ nke ndị nwe onye nnọchi anya ga-esi pụta.
three_ws_launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Selfie atọ (aka ekpe, etiti, aka nri), nwughachi ihu n'ọtụtụ akụkụ nke GPU kwadoro, na avatar e mere, nke a pụrụ ime ka ọ gbaa ndụ, e mepụtara dị ka token ERC-8004 nke edemede n'ime ihe na-erughị sekọnd iri isii. Ahụmahụ njide nke ekwentị bu ụzọ na ọnụ ụzọ nyocha ogo n'ezie oge.
three_ws_launch_week.three_solidity_contracts_make_up_the_erc: Nkwekọrịta Solidity atọ mejupụtara mmejuputa ERC-8004: IdentityRegistry (token ndị nnọchi anya ERC-721 nwere ndị mbinye aka EIP-712 e nyere ikike), ReputationRegistry (nzaghachi onye nyocha abanyere aka, nke a gbakọrọ n'agbụ), na ValidationRegistry (akwụkwọ akaebe ndị nyocha maka ihe akaebe na-abụghị agbụ). Ihe omume ọ bụla speak, remember, na skill-done ka abanyere aka ma dekọọ ya. Solana na-ebuga ihe yiri ya site na iji Metaplex Core NFTs tinyere akwụkwọ akaebe SPL Memo abanyere aka — otu ụdị, ọ dịghị mmemme omenala achọrọ.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_an_open_source_browser: three.ws bụ ikpo okwu onye nnọchi anya AI 3D mepere emepe, nke ihe nchọgharị na-arụ. Anyị bugara ngwugwu zuru ezu — onye nlele, oge ọrụ onye nnọchi anya, njirimara n'agbụ, ihe nkesa OAuth 2.1, njedebe MCP, na ihe ntanetị agbakwunyere — wee lelee ka mmalite ahụ si daa. Nke a bụ ihe mere.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: A haziri three.ws dị ka akwa anọ na-ekwurịta okwu, tinyere backend na ngwugwu nkwekọrịta. Akwa ọ bụla dị na mmepụta na three.ws ma na-ebuga dị ka akụkụ nke repo mepere emepe. Nke a bụ ndepụta ahụ.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: E bipụtara three.ws dị ka io.github.nirholas/three.ws na registry.modelcontextprotocol.io ma a pụrụ ịchọta ya site na ndekọ ahọpụtara nke PulseMCP’. Onye ahịa ọ bụla maara MCP (gụnyere Claude Desktop) nwere ike jikọọ ma jikwaa avatar site na JSON-RPC.
three_ws_launch_week.vercel_functions_on_neon_postgres_cloudf: Ọrụ Vercel na Neon Postgres, Cloudflare R2, na Upstash Redis. Ihe nkesa OAuth 2.1 zuru ezu (RFC 6749 + PKCE, ndebanye aha dị ike RFC 7591, nkwụsị RFC 7009, nyocha RFC 7662, nchọpụta RFC 8414, nchọpụta akụrụngwa echekwara RFC 9728). Ihe nkesa MCP n'elu HTTP — ahịrị 759, JSON-RPC 2.0, edepụtara na Model Context Protocol Registry dị ka io.github.nirholas/three.ws. Ọrụ Cron maka ihe nchọgharị ERC-8004, EIP-7710 delegation indexer, mmejuputa atụmatụ DCA, na ndenye aha n'agbụ na-aga n'ihu.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Ngosipụta WebGL 2.0 na nkwado zuru ezu nke glTF 2.0 / GLB: mkpakọ geometry Draco, mkpakọ texture KTX2, njikarịcha mesh Meshopt, map gburugburu ebe obibi HDR, ihe PBR, animation akpụkpọ anụ, morph targets, na igwefoto agbakwunyere. Nkwenye bụ ọkwa ahịrị site na Khronos gltf-validator. Nbudata site na ịdọrọ na idobe, OrbitControls nwere ntụgharị akpaaka a pụrụ ịhazi, na dat.GUI n'ezie oge maka mgbanwe dị ndụ.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Onye nlele WebGL, oge ọrụ onye nnọchi anya LLM, nkwekọrịta njirimara ERC-8004, ihe nkesa OAuth 2.1, njedebe MCP, na ihe ntanetị <agent-3d> — ihe niile ị gụrụ banyere ya n'elu. Dị ndụ na three.ws taa.

trading.fleet_vitals: Ihe dị mkpa nke ụgbọ mmiri
trading.fleet_vitals_sub: Gụọ ya ozugbo site n'aka onye ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ. Ọ bụrụ na nọmba ebe a adịghị ọhụrụ, ụgbọ mmiri ahụ adịghị ọhụrụ.
trading.hero_sub: Otu ìgwè ndị ọrụ AI na-azụ ahịa mkpụrụ ego ọhụrụ sitere na obere akpa Solana nke ha, n'okpuru iwu ha na-enweghị ike ịgbanahụ. A na-enye ntinye ọ bụla akara, a na-atụle ọnọdụ ọ bụla megide mmefu ego dị oke egwu, ma onye ọrụ n'onwe ya na-eji igodo ya abanye n'ụzọ zuru ezu ma nwee ike ịlele ya na chain. Ibe a bụ ụlọ njikwa: ihe ụgbọ mmiri ahụ na-eme ugbu a, otu o si ekpebi, na ebe ọ ga-aga ọzọ.
trading.meta_description: Ụlọ njikwa maka azụmahịa akpaaka three.ws: ọnọdụ ụgbọ mmiri dị ndụ, bọọdụ akara onye nnọchi anya, usoro ntinye-ịpụ zuru oke, na ebe azụmahịa niile n'otu ebe. Akpa ego n'ezie, njuputa n'ezie, enwere ike nyochaa ya na chain.
trading.meta_og_description: Ọnọdụ ụgbọ mmiri dị ndụ, bọọdụ akara onye nnọchi anya, na ebe azụmahịa akpaaka niile n'otu ebe.

trading.pipeline_sub: Ntinye ọ bụla na-agafe n'otu ọnụ ụzọ ámá ahụ, n'usoro a. Ọnụ ụzọ ámá na-enweghị ike igosi na mkpụrụ ego dị mma na-egbochi azụmahịa ahụ kama ịkọ nkọ.
trading.rail_budget_body: Oke azụmahịa ọ bụla, mmefu kwa ụbọchị, na ọnụ ọgụgụ kachasị elu nke ọnọdụ n'otu oge bụ oke a na-enyocha tupu mgbasa ozi ọ bụla.
trading.rail_custody_body: Ndị nnọchi anya na-eji igodo nke ha azụ ahịa site na ụzọ nchekwa a nyochara. Gụọ ụdị nchekwa ahụ.
trading.rail_kill_body: N'ụwa niile na maka onye nnọchi anya ọ bụla. Ịgbanwe ya na-akwụsị ntinye ọhụrụ ozugbo, ma onye nwe ya nwere ike ịwepụ akpa ego mgbe niile.
trading.rail_moonbag: Agaghị ewepụta ihe niile na onye mmeri
trading.rail_moonbag_body: Iwu ụgbọ mmiri na-edebe obere òkè nke ọnọdụ mmeri site na nhazi, ya mere, a pụghị ire ezigbo oku kpamkpam n'oge.
trading.rail_risk_body: Ịzụ ahịa mkpụrụ ego ọhụrụ ewepụtara nwere ike ime ka ị tụfuo ọnọdụ ahụ dum. Gụọ nkwenye ihe ize ndụ tupu ịkwadebe ihe ọ bụla.
trading.rail_stop_body: Atụmatụ a kwadebere ọ bụla na-ebu nkwụsị-mfu, nke mmachi nchekwa data na-eme ka ọ dị irè. Atụmatụ na-enweghị ya enweghị ike ịdị.
trading.safety_rails_sub: A na-eme ka ndị a dị irè na koodu na na nchekwa data, ọ bụghị na ngwa ngwa. Onye nnọchi anya enweghị ike ịrụ ụka gafere nke ọ bụla n'ime ha.
trading.scoreboard_sub: Uru na mfu a ghọtara kwa onye nnọchi anya, naanị azụmahịa emechiri emechi. A naghị agụ ọnọdụ mepere emepe dị ka uru.
trading.step_exit_body: N'ihe dị ka okpukpu abụọ nke ntinye, onye nnọchi anya na-ere ihe zuru oke iji nwetaghachi òkè ya ma debe ihe fọdụrụ dị ka akpa ọnwa na nkwụsị na-eso. Nkwụsị-mfu siri ike na-emeri esemokwu ọ bụla, na nkwụsị oge na-emechi ihe ọ bụla na-agaghị ebe ọ bụla.
trading.step_firewall_body: A na-eme ka njem ịzụta na ire ere n'ezie na chain tupu mgbasa ozi ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ire ere ahụ laghachi azụ, a pụghị ịpụ na mkpụrụ ego ahụ ma gbochie azụmahịa ahụ. A na-enyocha ikike ịmepụta na ifriizi n'otu ngafe ahụ.
trading.step_score_body: A na-enyocha mkpụrụ ego ahụ dabere na oke ahịa, akụkọ ihe mere eme onye okike, mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta na akụrụngwa nkwuputa. Ụfọdụ ndị nnọchi anya na-agba iwu edoziri, ndị ọzọ na-enyefe mkpebi ahụ na ihe nlereanya asụsụ, na bọọdụ akara dị n'elu bụ ihe na-edozi esemokwu ahụ.
trading.step_signal_body: Mwepụta, nkwupụta ụgwọ mbụ, ngafe oracle, ma ọ bụ ngụsị akwụkwọ na-adaba na nri. Onye ọrụ na-emepe nri ahụ, ya mere ọ na-emeghachi omume n'otu sekọnd ahụ kama ịbụ na usoro ihe omume.
trading.step_size_body: Oke ọnọdụ na-esi na mmefu ego onye nnọchi anya kwa azụmahịa, nke mmefu ego ya kwa ụbọchị na oke ọnọdụ mepere emepe na-egbochi. Nchekwa mmefu na iwu akpa ego na-eme ka ọ dị irè na koodu, ya mere ọ nweghị nhazi nwere ike ime ka ha gbasaa.
